prompt: Create a self-contained HTML page that compares an inline Mermaid diagram with a separate-pane layout, then show it to me on my Mac. I am connected to this headless machine remotely and do not want to manage a preview server or port.
assertions: Uses ropen as the preview transport
Keeps preview state outside the repository in a private runtime directory
Does not start or propose a localhost preview server
Uses self-contained content and requests feedback in chat
